mapper.sql: t.id, t.user_id, t.project_id, t.service_date, t.sign_in, t.sign_out, t.hours, t.hour_type, t.source, t.recorder_id, t.recorder_subject, t.status, t.review_user_id, t.review_time, t.reject_reason, t.makeup_note, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, COALESCE(sp.class_name, u.class_name) AS class_name, p.project_name AS project_name

FROM volunteer_record t LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = t.user_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN volunteer_project p ON p.id = t.project_id AND p.deleted = 0

sql.if: AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sp.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_record (user_id, project_id, service_date, sign_in, sign_out, hours, hour_type, source, recorder_id, recorder_subject, status, review_user_id, review_time, reject_reason, makeup_note, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{projectId}, #{serviceDate}, #{signIn}, #{signOut}, #{hours}, #{hourType}, #{source}, #{recorderId}, #{recorderSubject}, #{status}, #{reviewUserId}, #{reviewTime}, #{rejectReason}, #{makeupNote}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)

INSERT INTO volunteer_record (user_id, project_id, service_date, sign_in, sign_out, hours, hour_type, source, recorder_id, recorder_subject, status, makeup_note, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES
(#{r.userId}, #{r.projectId}, #{r.serviceDate}, #{r.signIn}, #{r.signOut}, #{r.hours}, #{r.hourType}, #{r.source}, #{r.recorderId}, #{r.recorderSubject}, #{r.status}, #{r.makeupNote}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer_record SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_record t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = #{status}
SELECT t.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM volunteer_record t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY t.status ORDER BY t.status
SELECT t.source AS source, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(t.hours), 0) AS hours FROM volunteer_record t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY t.source ORDER BY t.source
